statement.label: Ready for a set decision

statement.label: Whole-record exclusions
statement.note: Evidence supports removing the record. These stay apart from field edits.

statement.label: Already right in current FLoRA
statement.note: Current FLoRA already holds the proposed value, so no edit is needed.

statement.label: Proposal should be withdrawn
statement.note: Source review or both readings keep the existing value.

statement.label: Current FLoRA changed
statement.note: The row now holds a third value, or could not be matched with certainty. These need checking against current data.

statement.label: Corrected original needs a reference
statement.note: The source review supports a different original, but the proposal has no DOI to confirm its reference against an authoritative record.

statement.label: Awaiting a source review
statement.note: Two readings agree with the proposal, but nobody has yet tried to break it against the source.

statement.label: Waiting on a rule or a person
statement.note: The readings disagree or are unsure, or a coding rule needs settling.

statement.label: Blocked by the source
statement.note: The available text cannot settle this.

sets.title: Outcome corrections
sets.rule: Change the outcome and its supporting quote, when two independent full-text readings and a source review agree.

sets.title: Reproduction results
sets.rule: Change the computation or robustness result and its quote. The other result stays as it is.

sets.title: Study type with its outcome
sets.rule: Change the study type and the outcome together. Neither applies alone.
sets.route_note: The flora-validation editor cannot change a record type, and it only offers computation and robustness on a reproduction. A conversion needs a route agreed with the maintainers.

sets.title: Corrected original study
sets.rule: Replace the original study and its complete reference, confirmed against an authoritative record.

set_decision_note: Set decisions are not open yet. Individual review stays the route for any outcome until a named rule is decided.
